document.about: Cree Lighting CR4T downlight spec sheet, Canada (Word-made, 3 pages). Its field angle sets the degree sign as a small raised letter o after the number.

notes: 2026-11-23 (#77): a raised letter after a number of three figures was read as a note's letter. A raised o, 0 or º after a number that cannot take it as an ordinal ending is a degree.

checks.issue: The degree read as a note's letter: ~ 145 o.
